A principle of topology-cyberneering is the idea that if topology creates comittments in structure (like welding), then we must only introduce it when an object is satisfied (as it is currently understood, this is exclusively by necessity, though future objects may undoubtedly emerge.).

If we have a continous string: 1-2-3, but we need non-linearity, this requires decoupling of parts by reference; which is the topological opreation "diverge"
